fireKirin.credentialPolicy: EGM4000 opens this externally and never asks for, proxies, captures, stores, or transmits Fire Kirin credentials.

egm4000.status: Android v0.2 debug beta + persistent full-stack Web/PWA with integrated core-loop analysis and C006 Tips Center
egm4000.role: Gameplay intelligence, authorized evidence logging, normalized metrics/replay, confidence-calibrated coaching, community, privacy-safe surveys, and safe research.

fsa.status: separate owned product with authenticated exact-telemetry bridge contract implemented on the EGM4000 side
fsa.role: Owned virtual/non-cash fish shooter game that can emit exact telemetry to EGM4000 through the authenticated bridge.

founderConsole.status: separate owner/admin control-plane product; do not merge into EGM4000
founderConsole.role: Owner/admin console for owned-product settings, safety, virtual credits, content, experiments, moderation, surveys, and telemetry.

completed.C002: First-run guided tutorial with persisted seen/completed state and safe workflow education.
completed.C004: Community forum/blog with persistent backend, registered-user posting, reports, owner moderation and audit events.
completed.C005: Privacy-preserving visitor surveys with consent, first/returning/registered targeting, pseudonymous visitor identifiers, persistent responses and owner builder.
completed.C006: Session-derived Tips Center integrated with the shared full-stack core loop. Live/Android-synced evidence produces persistent coaching with provenance/evidence type, confidence, sample size, metrics and uncertainty.
completed.C010: Shared F.S.A. exact-telemetry fixture and validator added; integration CI validates the fixture and normalized contract.
completed.C011: Android Evidence Review v0.2 account-aware sync client is implemented; its legacy event aliases are normalized by the server into the shared core-loop vocabulary.
completed.C013: EGM4000-side authenticated F.S.A. telemetry bridge implemented with a deployment-secret token, stable external-session mapping, duplicate protection and virtual/non-cash credit enforcement.

incomplete.C003: Production owner/auth boundary exists in the full-stack foundation but still requires deployment hardening, recovery controls, production secret/provider configuration and final security validation.
incomplete.C007: The full 100-feature owner Admin Panel is not complete end-to-end.
incomplete.C008: A071-A095 monetization capabilities exist in the canonical model but are not all end-to-end implemented.
incomplete.C009: R001-R049 return-user features and adoption/retention instrumentation are not fully implemented.

coreLoopIntegration.rule: Analysis describes authorized recorded evidence only. Correlation is not causation and does not predict random outcomes or hidden server state.

exactTelemetryBoundary.rule: Only the separately owned F.S.A. integration may submit exact telemetry.
